easy.title: Introduce Yourself
easy.instruction: Say your name, age, grade, and favorite subject.
easy.example: My name is Aida. I am 12 years old. I am in Grade 6. My favorite subject is English.

easy.title: Five Words About Today
easy.instruction: Say five English words about your day and make one sentence.
easy.example: School, friend, lunch, homework, game. Today I went to school.

medium.title: My School Day
medium.instruction: Describe your school day in 4 sentences.
medium.example: I go to school in the morning. I study English and Math. I have lunch with my friends. I go home after classes.

medium.title: My Favorite Food
medium.instruction: Write 5 sentences about your favorite food.
medium.example: My favorite food is pizza. It is tasty. I eat it with my family. I like cheese. I can cook simple pizza.

hard.title: Why English Matters
hard.instruction: Speak for 45 seconds about why English is important.
hard.example: English is important because many people use it. It helps us travel, study, and communicate.

easy.title: About Me
easy.example: My name is Dana. I am 13 years old. I live in Kazakhstan. I like music. I want to improve my English.

medium.title: My Weekend
medium.instruction: Describe your last weekend using past tense.
medium.example: Last weekend, I visited my grandmother. I watched a movie. I did my homework. It was interesting.

medium.title: My Best Friend
medium.instruction: Write 6 sentences about your best friend.
medium.example: My best friend is kind. We study together. We like playing games. My friend helps me. I like spending time with my friend.

hard.title: Future Career
hard.instruction: Speak about your future career and explain your choice.
hard.example: I want to become a doctor because I want to help people. This job is difficult but important.
